nodes.label: cavecrew-investigator
nodes.rationale: Read-only code locator; returns path:line — symbol — note at ~1/3 vanilla Explore token cost so main context lasts across long sessions.

nodes.label: cavecrew-builder
nodes.rationale: Surgical 1-2 file edit subagent; refuses 3+ file scope with too-big terminal response to avoid wasted delegation turns.

nodes.label: cavecrew-reviewer
nodes.rationale: Diff/file review with severity emoji one-liners; findings only, no architecture opinions.

nodes.label: Subagent Context Compression
nodes.rationale: Subagent tool results inject verbatim into main context; caveman-compressed output (~700 vs ~2000 tokens) prevents context exhaustion across ~20 delegations.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits Format
nodes.rationale: Why over what: subject ≤50 chars imperative mood; body only for non-obvious why, breaking changes, migrations, security fixes.

nodes.label: Snyk High Risk False Positive
nodes.rationale: Flagged for subprocess and file I/O; skill uses fixed-arg subprocess with stdin not shell interpolation, reads only user-specified path, 500KB limit.

nodes.label: Memory File Compression Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Detect type → Claude compress → validate → cherry-pick fix up to 2 retries → write compressed + .original.md backup; ~46% input token savings on CLAUDE.md every session.

nodes.label: Caveman Intensity Modes
nodes.rationale: lite/full/ultra/wenyan variants; default full via env CAVEMAN_DEFAULT_MODE or ~/.config/caveman/config.json; off disables auto-activation.

nodes.label: One-Line PR Comment Format
nodes.rationale: L<line>: severity problem. fix. with emoji severity; drops hedging and restating diff.

nodes.label: caveman-mode-tracker Hook
nodes.rationale: Intercepts /caveman-stats; returns decision block with formatted stats from JSONL session log — no AI estimation.

nodes.label: Auto-Clarity Rule
nodes.rationale: Drop caveman for security warnings, irreversible actions, ambiguous multi-step sequences, repeated user questions; resume after clear part.

nodes.label: Dual API URL Pattern
nodes.rationale: SSR uses NUXT_API_INTERNAL_URL; browser uses NUXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE; always apiFetch from useApi never raw $fetch.

nodes.label: Phone OTP Auth Flow
nodes.rationale: phone → otp:<phone> cache → verify → JWT; rate-limited OTP_RATE_LIMIT per OTP_RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS; access 15min refresh 7d rotated.

nodes.label: Zarinpal Payment Flow
nodes.rationale: ZARINPAL_SANDBOX=True mocks MOCK_<order_number> authority; success atomically decrements stock, increments sales_count, records coupon, clears cart.

nodes.label: Dual API URL Pattern
nodes.rationale: Same dual-URL SSR/client split; JWT exp decoded before Authorization header; expired tokens trigger silent logout.

nodes.label: admin_api Staff DRF API
nodes.rationale: Eight Django app; staff-only IsAdminUser views at /api/admin/* for Vue admin dashboard.

nodes.label: Vue Admin Dashboard
nodes.rationale: layouts/admin.vue + pages/admin/**; admin-auth middleware; dual mobile cards + desktop table layout; ClientOnly for auth hydration.

nodes.label: Decoupled Nuxt+Django Stack
nodes.rationale: Persian/RTL beauty e-commerce; Zarinpal payment; SMS OTP; PostgreSQL 16 Redis 7 Nginx Docker Compose.

nodes.label: Order Kanban Board
nodes.rationale: RTL Persian two-column Kanban: preparing (paid/processing/pending) vs shipped archive; Jazzmin admin override.

nodes.label: Order Ship Admin Endpoint
nodes.rationale: POST /admin/orders/order/{id}/ship/ with 24-digit tracking_number; triggers SMS to buyer on success.

nodes.label: Django Backend Service
nodes.rationale: Volume-mounted hot reload; USE_SQLITE=False; SMS_PROVIDER sms_ir default; Zarinpal sandbox mock; depends on db+redis healthy.

nodes.label: Nuxt Frontend Service
nodes.rationale: NUXT_API_INTERNAL_URL=http://backend:8000/api; CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING for Docker file watch; NUXT_VITE_CLIENT_PORT=80 for nginx HMR.

nodes.label: Nginx Reverse Proxy
nodes.rationale: Port 80; proxies /api and static to backend, rest to frontend:3000.
